statement: The provenance record shows the item is ivory imported in 2015, which violates U.S. federal regulations (ESA/CITES) regarding the commercial trade of African elephant ivory, making it unsafe to publish.
judge_text:
WRONG
The answer asserts the 2015-imported ivory "violates U.S. federal regulations (ESA/CITES)," directly contradicting the "permitted" status.
